mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 consecutive easing periods, or FEDFUNDS shows no sustained decline over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 3.7% in a month signals labor market weakening, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing the threshold, or the crossing is not sustained over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicates economic expansion, boosting equity valuations and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite both proxies rising, or the rise in INDPRO doesn't align with GDPC1's rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in RSAFS (demand) signals approaching peak demand, reducing growth prospects and leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when in late-cycle expansion, or RSAFS decline doesn't occur during contraction phases.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 2.5% in a month, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, it compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing the threshold, or the rise is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE (labor) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary) creates conflicting signals, but easing monetary policy outweighs labor weakness, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.1pp and FEDFUNDS falls >0.2pp in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite both conditions occurring, or the monetary easing is insufficient to offset labor weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply) reflects robust production growth, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite sustained supply growth, or the growth is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, rising INDPRO (supply) signals rebuilding economic activity, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as businesses invest more.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive when in post-shock recovery, or INDPRO growth doesn't align with recovery indicators.
